question: Faiyyaz Khan, Latafat Hussein Khan and Dinkar Kaikini are famous exponents from which of the following Gharanas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Agra Gharana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Faiyyaz Khan, Latafat Hussein Khan, and Dinkar Kaikini are celebrated exponents of the **Agra Gharana**, a prominent school of Hindustani classical music.
 
• The **Agra Gharana** is known for its unique blend of dhrupad and khayal styles, emphasizing intricate layakari (rhythmic interplay) and bol-baant (syllabic patterns).
 
• Faiyyaz Khan, a legendary vocalist of the Agra Gharana, was one of the most influential figures in the history of Hindustani classical music.
 
• Agra Gharana traces its origins back to the 14th century, with its roots in the dhrupad tradition and contributions from musicians like Nayak Gopal and Nayak Khanderao.
 
• The Gharana emphasizes a powerful voice culture and extensive use of meend (gliding notes) in its renditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gharanas in Hindustani Classical Music:**

 
 
• Gharanas are schools or styles of Hindustani classical music, each having distinct characteristics and traditions.
 
• Prominent Gharanas include Agra, Jaipur-Atrauli, Kirana, Benaras, and Patiala, among others.
 
• Each Gharana specializes in unique techniques, such as voice modulation, improvisation, and rhythmic patterns.
 
 
 
• **Dhrupad and Khayal:**
 
 
• Dhrupad is the oldest vocal style in Hindustani classical music, characterized by its solemn and meditative nature.
 
• Khayal, meaning "imagination," is a more flexible and expressive style that evolved from dhrupad.
 
• The Agra Gharana blends both styles, retaining the depth of dhrupad while exploring the creativity of khayal.
 
 
 
• **Faiyyaz Khan:**
 
 
• Faiyyaz Khan was awarded the title "Aftab-e-Mousiqui" (Sun of Music) for his unparalleled contribution to Hindustani classical music.
 
• His renditions were marked by powerful voice projection and intricate rhythmic elaborations.
 
 
 
• **Other Exponents:**
 
 
• Latafat Hussein Khan was known for his soulful khayal singing and mastery over classical compositions.
 
• Dinkar Kaikini contributed significantly to the propagation of the Agra Gharana and trained many students in its traditions.
